response.sql: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALB - l.TP) as avg_alb_minus_tp, AVG(l.APPT - l.PT) as avg_appt_minus_pt FROM Patient p INNER JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), sex_averages AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_alb_minus_tp) as sex_avg_alb_minus_tp, AVG(avg_appt_minus_pt) as sex_avg_appt_minus_pt FROM patient_averages GROUP BY SEX), overall_stats AS (SELECT AVG(sex_avg_appt_minus_pt) as overall_mean_appt FROM sex_averages), filtered_sexes AS (SELECT sa.sex_avg_alb_minus_tp, sa.sex_avg_appt_minus_pt, ov.overall_mean_appt FROM sex_averages sa CROSS JOIN overall_stats ov WHERE sa.sex_avg_appt_minus_pt > ov.overall_mean_appt) SELECT AVG(sex_avg_alb_minus_tp) as avg_alb_minus_tp, AVG(sex_avg_appt_minus_pt) as avg_appt_minus_pt, AVG(sex_avg_appt_minus_pt) - MAX(overall_mean_appt) as excess FROM filtered_sexes
